listing.name: Baldur's Gate (original) (GemRB)
listing.summary: Set up Baldur's Gate (original) through its upstream gemrb player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use this original game and edition
steps.instruction: Use a complete installed original Baldur’s Gate working copy, including its original resources and any deliberately installed expansion. Enhanced Edition files and the bundled trivial demo are different inputs. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the real player
steps.instruction: Use a complete upstream GemRB build with its plugins, scripts and supplied configuration, not just a loose executable. GitHub release metadata has no binary asset to recommend. Give this game its own configuration: GamePath points to a separate complete working copy of the installed original; GameType=bg1. Use the configuration supplied with your actual build rather than leaving @...@ development-template placeholders. Register gemrb.exe with the complete GemRB installation as working directory and two literal argument lines, -c then the absolute path to this game’s configuration.

steps.title: Keep the actual original and player data
steps.instruction: Choose a dedicated empty private CachePath for this game: GemRB clears that directory, so it must never be your originals, saves or profile root. SavePath is the parent containing save/, not save/ itself. Keep a separate SavePath per game. GemRB can also write gem-*.ini into GamePath before trying SavePath, so preserve and use a working data copy; SavePath alone does not isolate original installation writes. Preserve that working copy, actual save/config locations and mods with GemRB closed before updates. Do not move saves between different games or editions.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream setup first. Registration saves your selected executable, working directory and literal arguments; Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this external runtime, original files and profile. Registration-only removal preserves them. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are not offered for these external files. Preserve a working copy and its data before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own supported upstream application/native flow.

warnings: GemRB clears its cache directory. Use a dedicated private CachePath, separate from original files, saves and profile roots.
